professionalSummary: Seasoned Platform Engineer with 2½ years of hands‑on experience managing production message queue clusters, executing broker upgrades, tiered storage migrations, and capacity planning for high‑traffic topics. Proven track record of on‑call incident response, including partition leader storms and consumer lag events, and meticulous documentation of cluster changes and hand‑over procedures.
experienceHighlights:
Deployed three production cluster changes, including two broker version upgrades and a tiered storage migration, each documented in a change record. 

Handled all on‑call incidents during shifts, notably a July 2024 partition leader storm and four consumer lag incidents, logged in the platform incident log. 

Monitored live throughput and lag dashboards post‑deployment and coordinated capacity adjustments with owners of six busiest topics, recording responsibilities in change records. 

Conducted staged testing of every cluster change using a documented load profile, attaching results to change records. 

Documented cluster limitations and hand‑over conditions in change record closures and the platform runbook.
projectsAndWorkSamples:
Change records for broker upgrades and tiered storage move, including staging results. 
Platform incident log entries for July 2024 leader storm and four lag incidents.

On the platform on-call rota throughout and handled the production incidents on my shifts, including the partition leader storm of July 2024 and four consumer lag incidents, all recorded in the platform incident log.
Platform incident log records for the July 2024 leader storm and the four lag incidents

Watched the live throughput and lag dashboards after each change and ran the capacity changes with the owning teams of the six busiest topics, recording in each change record which checks were mine and which were the topic owners'
Change records with capacity change details
Tested each cluster change on the staging clusters under the documented load profile before production deployment, with the staging results attached to the change record.
Documented cluster limitations and the hand-over conditions for each change in the change record's closure section and in the platform runbook.
